reviews.text: Two visits, two days, 3 pets. Absolutely phenomenal. The vet techs were so bubbly and friendly with my cats and dog. The front desk was nice and explained everything. The vet himself was incredibly understanding and thorough. I wish I found this place sooner. Highly recommend!

I appreciated the physician's transparent approach in avoiding unnecessary charges for conditions clearly identifiable via the provided imagery. Although I did not proceed with the intended urinalysis, I value the integrity of receiving an honest second opinion.
Even when the power went out they were able to take care of my dog and his well being

Took Lola in on June 4th for possibly allergies and found out she also had a skin infection after being on antibiotics and apaqual for 24 hours she's doing much better thanks to Doc. and staff . I would highly recommend this place for anyone needing care for their furry friends.Thank you so much.  7/17/24 Staff is still as wonderful as the first time we took Lola, Lola just goes crazy when she sees all the staff, I would highly recommend this place for all your furry babies 😄 On July  2nd took Lola in for her yearly shots and flea and tick protection at that time I found out she had a skin infection she was put on an antibiotic and anti-itch medication and within 48 hours she's doing much better this PET VACCINE CLINIC has always been able to treat Lola from her allergies to her skin infection and yearly vaccines and prices are very reasonable.  Thanks for taking sure good care of our furry baby

I had to euthanize my 15 year old cat and the drs and staff were so good to me
I cried with my cat for over 2 hours and I wasn’t rushed out of the room. She was picked up for cremation  it was quick , my cat was at peace !
Very helpful and courteous
Best pet clinic would recommend highly.  Veterinarian Doctor and staff friendly and efficient!!!
Such a great experience!!! The front desk was VERY helpful, and the Dr. Was amazing at helping my dog with her cracked nail. Truly grateful for my local vet!!

Dr. Leland is very knowledgeable & that is invaluable.  You want your pet diagnosed properly with the correct treatment, with this knowledge he can also rule out unnecessary testing, his knowledge helps save you time, money & from stress.  Some of the other vets nearby are HORRIBLE & will keep you coming back because they can't figure something out or don't prescribe the proper treatment.  I never had to wait too long whenever I come here either.
I been coming here for the past 3 years! Everyone in the office is super nice, they treat my dog well everytime I take her to get her annuals.
The staff is very friendly and always helpful with your pet's needs; if they don't offer a particular service, they'll share their best recommendations.

I'm not originally from here. I'm from New Jersey. In that I see different types of people as far as the way they interact down here.
And this place is definitely A. Testament, 2. The reason why I look down here now, the Doctor you're great. The staff is awesome.
And they just come across as not only good people but people who actually care about animals. I bring my cats louis and lance here and now a new member of our family topper. And so far, they give 2 paws up to this place. Keep up the great work guys. I won't go anywhere else

Great clinic for vaccines and any type of small issues. Never have to wait long to see the doc. Definitely go here if all you need are vaccines.

Love this place. My dog is healthy and her trips here are always inexpensive. Doctor is very honest if he feels his office can’t accommodate. And seems to be ready to recommend it.  I like an office that’s not trying to upsell treatments.

It was my first time going to the vet, they handled my pet with care, and professionalism, there was a miscommunication for the things that I asked for, but the manager priced matched and resolved it no problem, will bring my pet here again, and recommend this place for pet owners. Very satisfied.
Excellent veterinarian
Friendliest staff and vet I have ever met. First time taking our puppy and will be coming back. Also great prices compared to other vets.

Very friendly receptionist and other workers. Thank you for being very friendly and very refined to my fur babies.

I was very and am still impressed by the main vet here; he's fast lol normally my cat can get aggressive but the vet moved so quick my cat didn't have time to react. Also you can really "feel" the lack of bad intentions... sounds weird but cats get FREAKED by bad "vibes." My visit was a year or 2 ago but I am planning on returning soon.

As newcomers to the area, finding a great veterinary office was a priority, and we feel incredibly lucky to have found this one! The entire staff and doctors have been exceptionally friendly and welcoming. We especially appreciated the doctors' wonderful demeanor with our pets – it truly put us at ease.

They take great care of my pet.  Staff is always friendly and answer my questions. Best part, I went in with my pet and was there when he got his check up. Thank you Pet Vaccination Clinic.

We have entrusted the care and health of all our family pets to Dr. Leland and his staff for many, many years. They are a happy group, the staff and doctor Leland are so caring of each pet they see. Our pets love to visit Pet Vaccination Clinic, they remember Dr. Leland and the staff. Dr. Leland helped us through a very tough time last year when we finally had to let go of our Buddy so he could rest. We were a mess, but he was very patient and kind in helping us work through it.  A Compassionate Clinic
